articles.title: Transcarent Introduces New Bundled Payment Solution for Advanced Cancer Care
articles.summary: Transcarent has launched an innovative bundled payment model designed specifically to manage the high costs and clinical complexities associated with breakthrough cancer therapies for self-funded employers. This development matters because oncology spending represents one of the fastest-growing cost drivers in employer-sponsored health plans, demanding better financial predictability and care coordination. For employee benefits and pharmacy management, this model offers a potential pathway to mitigate extreme specialty drug exposure while ensuring members receive high-quality, value-based cancer treatment.
